#

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(purrr)
  library(stringr)
  library(tibble)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(circlize)
  library(grid)
})

# ============================================================
# Define input and output directories
# ============================================================

CNV_DIR <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WES/Downstream/PCGR/CNV_PCGR/Plot"
OUT_DIR <- file.path(CNV_DIR, "Figures")

dir.create(OUT_DIR, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cat("[INFO] CNV input directory:", CNV_DIR, "\n")
cat("[INFO] Output directory:", OUT_DIR, "\n\n")
```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Find sample-level CNV CSV files
# ============================================================
# Important:
#   We only keep files like TP03-117_T.csv
#   This avoids reading summary files such as:
#     CNV_merge_summary.csv
#     CNV_file_grouping_summary.csv

files <- sort(list.files(
  CNV_DIR,
  pattern = "^TP.*_T\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
))

cat("[INFO] Sample CNV CSV files found:", length(files), "\n")

if (length(files) == 0) {
  stop("[ERROR] No sample-level CNV CSV files found. Check CNV_DIR or filename pattern.")
}

cat("[INFO] Files used:\n")
print(basename(files))

```
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Sanity check column structure
# ============================================================

get_cols <- function(f) {
  hdr <- read_lines(f, n_max = 1)

  if (length(hdr) == 0 || nchar(hdr[1]) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      file = basename(f),
      empty = TRUE,
      ncol = NA_integer_,
      cols = list(character())
    ))
  }

  cols <- str_split(hdr[1], ",", simplify = FALSE)[[1]] %>%
    str_replace_all('"', "") %>%
    str_trim()

  tibble(
    file = basename(f),
    empty = FALSE,
    ncol = length(cols),
    cols = list(cols)
  )
}

hdr_df <- map_dfr(files, get_cols)

cat("\n====================================================\n")
cat("[SANITY] File count + column count\n")
cat("====================================================\n")

print(hdr_df %>% select(file, empty, ncol))

if (any(hdr_df$empty)) {
  cat("\n[WARN] Empty files detected:\n")
  print(hdr_df %>% filter(empty) %>% select(file))
}

# Use first non-empty file as reference
ref_cols <- hdr_df %>%
  filter(!empty) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  pull(cols) %>%
  .[[1]]

ref_file <- hdr_df %>%
  filter(!empty) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  pull(file)

cmp_df <- hdr_df %>%
  mutate(
    same_as_ref = map_lgl(cols, ~ identical(.x, ref_cols)),
    missing_vs_ref = map_chr(cols, ~ paste(setdiff(ref_cols, .x), collapse = ";")),
    extra_vs_ref   = map_chr(cols, ~ paste(setdiff(.x, ref_cols), collapse = ";"))
  )

cat("\n====================================================\n")
cat("[SANITY] Column matching vs reference\n")
cat("====================================================\n")
cat("[INFO] Reference file:", ref_file, "\n")
cat("[INFO] Reference columns:\n")
cat(paste(ref_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

print(cmp_df %>% select(file, same_as_ref))

mismatch <- cmp_df %>% filter(!empty, !same_as_ref)

if (nrow(mismatch) == 0) {
  cat("\n[DONE] All non-empty files have identical column names and order.\n")
} else {
  cat("\n[WARN] Mismatched files detected:\n")

  print(
    mismatch %>%
      transmute(
        file,
        ncol,
        missing_vs_ref = ifelse(missing_vs_ref == "", "NONE", missing_vs_ref),
        extra_vs_ref   = ifelse(extra_vs_ref == "", "NONE", extra_vs_ref)
      )
  )
}

write_csv(
  cmp_df %>% select(file, empty, ncol, same_as_ref, missing_vs_ref, extra_vs_ref),
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "WES_CNV_column_sanity.csv")
)

```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Helper function to read and clean one CNV file
# ============================================================

read_cnv_clean <- function(f) {

  sample_name <- str_replace(basename(f), "\\.csv$", "")

  df <- read_csv(
    f,
    show_col_types = FALSE,
    progress = FALSE,
    name_repair = "minimal"
  )

  # Drop first blank row-name column if present
  # Original PCGR header may begin with:
  # "","SYMBOL","GENENAME",...
  if (ncol(df) > 0 && names(df)[1] %in% c("", "...1", "X1")) {
    df <- df[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  }

  required_cols <- c("SYMBOL", "VARIANT_CLASS")

  missing_required <- setdiff(required_cols, names(df))

  if (length(missing_required) > 0) {
    stop(
      paste0(
        "[ERROR] Missing required columns in ",
        basename(f),
        ": ",
        paste(missing_required, collapse = ", ")
      )
    )
  }

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      Sample = sample_name,
      Merged_File = basename(f),
      .before = 1
    )

  return(df)
}
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# Read all WES CNV files
# ============================================================

cnv_all <- map_dfr(files, read_cnv_clean)

cat("\n====================================================\n")
cat("[INFO] Combined CNV table\n")
cat("====================================================\n")
cat("[INFO] Total rows:", nrow(cnv_all), "\n")
cat("[INFO] Total samples:", n_distinct(cnv_all$Sample), "\n")
cat("[INFO] Total unique genes:", n_distinct(cnv_all$SYMBOL), "\n")

write_tsv(
  cnv_all,
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "WES_PCGR_CNV_combined_long.tsv")
)

# ============================================================
# Count unique genes per sample
# ============================================================

per_sample_genes <- cnv_all %>%
  transmute(
    Sample,
    SYMBOL = str_trim(as.character(SYMBOL))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SYMBOL), SYMBOL != "") %>%
  distinct(Sample, SYMBOL) %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  summarise(unique_genes = n_distinct(SYMBOL), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(unique_genes))

cat("\n====================================================\n")
cat("[SUMMARY] Unique CNV genes per sample\n")
cat("====================================================\n")
print(per_sample_genes)

write_tsv(
  per_sample_genes,
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "WES_unique_CNV_genes_per_sample.tsv")
)
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# Find recurrent CNV genes
# ============================================================

gene_frequency <- cnv_all %>%
  transmute(
    Sample,
    SYMBOL = str_trim(as.character(SYMBOL))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SYMBOL), SYMBOL != "") %>%
  distinct(Sample, SYMBOL) %>%
  group_by(SYMBOL) %>%
  summarise(n_samples = n_distinct(Sample), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_samples), SYMBOL)

all_unique_genes <- gene_frequency %>%
  select(SYMBOL, n_samples)

# Change this threshold if needed
min_samples <- 8

recurrent_genes <- gene_frequency %>%
  filter(n_samples >= min_samples)

cat("\n====================================================\n")
cat("[SUMMARY] Recurrent CNV genes\n")
cat("====================================================\n")
cat("[INFO] Minimum samples threshold:", min_samples, "\n")
cat("[INFO] Total recurrent genes:", nrow(recurrent_genes), "\n")
print(recurrent_genes)

write_tsv(
  all_unique_genes,
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "WES_all_unique_CNV_genes.tsv")
)

write_tsv(
  recurrent_genes,
  file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0("WES_recurrent_CNV_genes_min", min_samples, ".tsv"))
)
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# Normalize CNV variant classes
# ============================================================
# PCGR commonly uses classes such as:
#   Gain, Hetdel, Homdel
#
# This function is slightly flexible in case values appear as:
#   HETD, HOMD, AMP, HLAMP, etc.

normalize_class <- function(x) {

  x <- str_to_lower(str_trim(as.character(x)))

  case_when(
    x %in% c("hetdel", "het_del", "hetd", "heterozygous deletion", "het deletion") ~ "Hetdel",
    x %in% c("homdel", "hom_del", "homd", "homozygous deletion", "hom deletion") ~ "Homdel",
    x %in% c("gain", "amp", "amplification", "hlamp", "high-level amplification") ~ "Gain",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

# Severity priority if one gene has multiple CNV calls in the same sample
# Most severe call will be used for heatmap
priority <- c(
  "Homdel" = 3,
  "Hetdel" = 2,
  "Gain"   = 1,
  "None"   = 0
)

# ============================================================
# Prepare CNV table for heatmap
# ============================================================

cnv_long <- cnv_all %>%
  transmute(
    Sample = as.character(Sample),
    SYMBOL = str_trim(as.character(SYMBOL)),
    VARIANT_CLASS = normalize_class(VARIANT_CLASS)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Sample), Sample != "",
    !is.na(SYMBOL), SYMBOL != "",
    !is.na(VARIANT_CLASS)
  )

cat("\n====================================================\n")
cat("[INFO] CNV classes after normalization\n")
cat("====================================================\n")
print(table(cnv_long$VARIANT_CLASS))

# Collapse to one CNV class per Sample × Gene
cnv_onecall <- cnv_long %>%
  mutate(score = unname(priority[VARIANT_CLASS])) %>%
  group_by(Sample, SYMBOL) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = score, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Sample, SYMBOL, VARIANT_CLASS)

write_tsv(
  cnv_onecall,
  file.path(OUT_DIR, "WES_PCGR_CNV_onecall_per_gene_sample.tsv")
)

# Keep genes recurrent in >= min_samples
gene_freq_plot <- cnv_onecall %>%
  distinct(Sample, SYMBOL) %>%
  count(SYMBOL, name = "n_samples") %>%
  filter(n_samples >= min_samples) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_samples), SYMBOL)

genes_keep <- gene_freq_plot$SYMBOL

cat("\n====================================================\n")
cat("[INFO] Genes kept for heatmap\n")
cat("====================================================\n")
cat("[INFO] Genes kept >= ", min_samples, " samples: ", length(genes_keep), "\n", sep = "")

if (length(genes_keep) == 0) {
  stop("[ERROR] No recurrent genes found for heatmap. Try lowering min_samples.")
}
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# Create heatmap matrix
# ============================================================

samples <- sort(unique(cnv_onecall$Sample))

heat_df <- cnv_onecall %>%
  filter(SYMBOL %in% genes_keep) %>%
  transmute(SYMBOL, Sample, VAR = VARIANT_CLASS)

mat_chr <- heat_df %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Sample, values_from = VAR) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(mat_chr) <- mat_chr$SYMBOL
mat_chr$SYMBOL <- NULL

# Ensure all sample columns exist
missing_cols <- setdiff(samples, colnames(mat_chr))

if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  mat_chr[missing_cols] <- NA_character_
}

mat_chr <- mat_chr[, samples, drop = FALSE]

# Fill missing values as None
mat_chr[is.na(mat_chr)] <- "None"

# Order genes by recurrence
mat_chr <- mat_chr[genes_keep, , drop = FALSE]

mat_chr <- as.matrix(mat_chr)
storage.mode(mat_chr) <- "character"

mat_fac <- matrix(
  factor(
    as.vector(mat_chr),
    levels = c("None", "Hetdel", "Homdel", "Gain")
  ),
  nrow = nrow(mat_chr),
  ncol = ncol(mat_chr),
  dimnames = dimnames(mat_chr)
)
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# Define colors
# ============================================================

class_cols <- c(
  "Hetdel" = "#8C6D31",  # brown
  "Homdel" = "#D7301F",  # red
  "Gain"   = "#31A354",  # green
  "None"   = "#FFFFFF"   # white
)
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# Row annotation - CNV class counts per gene
# ============================================================

count_mat <- sapply(
  c("Hetdel", "Homdel", "Gain"),
  function(cl) rowSums(mat_chr == cl)
)

colnames(count_mat) <- c("Hetdel", "Homdel", "Gain")

# Maximum total CNV count per gene across classes
max_count <- max(rowSums(count_mat), na.rm = TRUE)

# Round up to nearest multiple of 3
max_axis <- ceiling(max_count / 3) * 3

axis_ticks <- seq(0, max_axis, by = 3)

row_ha <- rowAnnotation(
  `Class counts` = anno_barplot(
    count_mat,
    gp = gpar(
      fill = class_cols[colnames(count_mat)],
      col = NA
    ),
    border = FALSE,
    bar_width = 0.95,
    xlim = c(0, max_axis),
    axis_param = list(
      at = axis_ticks,
      labels = axis_ticks,
      gp = gpar(fontsize = 9)
    )
  ),
  width = unit(2.8, "cm")
)
```


```{r}
# ============================================================
# Generate heatmap
# ============================================================

show_x_names <- TRUE
column_names_rot <- if (show_x_names) 45 else 0

# font settings
txt_gp_row <- gpar(fontsize = 10, col = "black", fontfamily = "sans")
txt_gp_col <- gpar(fontsize = 10, col = "black", fontfamily = "sans")


ht_w <- unit(8, "cm")
ht_h <- unit(0.15 * nrow(mat_fac), "in")


ht <- Heatmap(
  mat_fac,
  name = "CNV class",
  col = class_cols,

  cluster_rows = FALSE,
  cluster_columns = FALSE,
  show_row_dend = FALSE,
  show_column_dend = FALSE,

  show_column_names = show_x_names,
  column_names_rot = column_names_rot,

  row_names_side = "left",
  column_names_side = "bottom",
  row_names_gp = txt_gp_row,
  column_names_gp = txt_gp_col,
  
  rect_gp = gpar(col = "grey80", lwd = 0.6),
  na_col = class_cols["None"],

  width = ht_w,
  height = ht_h,

  heatmap_legend_param = list(
    at = c("Hetdel", "Homdel", "Gain"),
    labels = c("Hetdel", "Homdel", "Gain"),
    labels_gp = gpar(col = "black", fontsize = 10),
    title_gp  = gpar(col = "black", fontsize = 11, fontface = "bold")
  )
)

draw(
  ht + row_ha,
  heatmap_legend_side = "right",
  annotation_legend_side = "right",
  padding = unit(c(25, 10, 25, 10), "mm")
)
```
